An employee became light-headed and suffered an asthma attack while delivering mail. Heat may have been a contributing factor.

An employee was cleaning basement materials out from underneath a pot. As the employee was walking backward, his foot became caught under a metal pad, causing him to fall and sustain a right tibia and fibula fracture.

An employee was lifting an 8 ft. x 20 ft. 1/4" flat sheet of steel with a crane to be transported to the burn table to be cut when it slipped out of the lifting plate clamp and fell on his right foot.  He sustained four fractures in his right foot.
An employee was adjusting the tote straps on a trailer when he fell off the trailer and struck his head on the ground. He sustained a concussion and bruised ribs.
An employee was troubleshooting an electrical circuit in an electrical cabinet at the base of a wind turbine when an arc flash occurred, causing second degree burns to the employee's right hand.

On January 5, 2023, an employee was operating a stand-up electric forklift to rearrange wooden pallets in a warehouse. The forklift struck a concrete pole and the employee's thumb was pinched between the pole and the forklift, resulting in a fractured thumb.
An employee was sorting packages on a caster dock when he fell from the dock to the floor below. He was hospitalized with broken ribs and a collapsed lung.

An employee was kneeling on the floor, looking through material under a desk that was next to a metal exterior door. A gust of wind blew the door closed, and his left little finger was caught in its frame. The fingertip was amputated.

The injured employee had been working on the computer at the front desk in the showroom. An argument occurred with another employee and additional people got involved. Gunshots were fired. The employee was shot in the hip and was hospitalized.
On 6/22/2022, an employee was placing a shirt on a heat transfer machine when the heat plate came down on her hands resulting in burns to both thumbs.
An employee was cleaning the interior portion of a grain bin when their foot was caught in an open sump pit where a drag was operating and their foot was fractured. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was running the floor scrubber while other employees were cleaning up glass bottles. One glass bottle was put in the hopper and shattered. A glass fragment hit an employee's head and went into the employee's left eye causing a laceration to the cornea.

The employee was cleaning the windshield of a semi-truck with the hood of the truck open.  He finished cleaning the windshield and went to step down when his wedding ring caught on the hood.  The weight of the employee's body and the ring being caught on the hood caused the hood to cut the employee's finger.  The finger was later amputated at the hospital.
An employee was moving product between pallets. The employee's leg got caught in shrink wrap, and the employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken leg.
An employee suffered a finger amputation while cleaning a mixer machine. The machine was guarded and energized at the time.
On January 11, 2024, an employee was cleaning a card machine when their finger was pulled into the rollers, resulting in an amputation to the right index finger.

An employee was cleaning an extruder throat with a putty knife. The knife became caught and the employee's right index finger came into contact with the extruder screw. About 3/8 inch of the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was installing exterior drywall while working in a boom lift. The employee suffered six fractured ribs when caught between the boom lift basket and a structural I-beam. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a deli slicer with a rag. The slicer caught the rag and pulled the employee's finger into the slicer, cutting it.
An employee was hospitalized with a head injury after a slip, trip, and fall incident on an icy working surface.
While cleaning the kitchen area, an employee slipped on grease on the floor, fracturing his hip and requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was inside a chute, cleaning dust, when he slipped and cut his right elbow on an object inside chute.

An employee was loading concrete traffic barriers onto a semi trailer when he tripped, causing his foot to become caught between the pins that hold the barriers together and the step deck of the trailer. The employee sustained a compound fracture to the lower right leg and fractures to the foot/ankle. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was cleaning a short weight tumbler machine when her hand was caught between the machine, amputating part of her thumb and breaking several bones in her hand.

On or about April 6, 2016, an employee was cleaning a food slicer when her right ring fingertip contacted the spinning blade and was amputated. The slicer was unguarded and running at the time of the incident.
On 6/16/15, an employee was injured when he slipped off the forks of a forklift and fell 5 to 6 feet. The employee was hospitalized with cracked ribs and a groin injury.
An employee was riding a lift gate when his right foot was caught between the lift gate and trailer, resulting in the amputation of his middle and fourth right toes.
An employee was entering a building after cleaning a floor drain in a courtyard. He slipped and fell down a flight of 7 stairs, coming to rest on a landing and suffering a broken left ankle.
An employee was hooking a welder gun into a feeding wire. The feeder caught the employee's right thumb, which was amputated. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to repair a chain conveyor that pulls fence posts from one area of the facility to another. The employee used the emergency stop to shut the conveyor down. The machine wasn't locked out and tagged. At some point another employee turned the conveyor back on while the maintenance employee still had his hand on the conveyor chain. The employee lost his whole middle finger and the tip of his left pointer finger.
An employee was using a rebar bending machine. The machine activated, catching the employee's left hand in a pinch point. He suffered an amputation to the left ring finger and was hospitalized.
An employee was spotting for a forklift. While reversing, it struck him on the left side. He suffered two broken bones in the foot and a displaced lateral malleolus fracture.

An employee was walking on stilts to his working area. He was working in a computer room (raised floor) that was covered in tile squares. Someone had removed a carpeted tile and he fell between the false floor and carpeted sections of the floor, dislocating his left elbow and breaking his right wrist.

An employee was performing janitorial activities and unclogging a toilet and drain line that had shop rags and paper towels in it. After snaking the line to remove the obstruction, he was using a drain cleaning product and after about 20 minutes he became dizzy and lost consciousness as he was walking out of the room. He fell to the floor and sustained two fractured cervical vertebrae and bruising to the spine. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were inspecting an electrical cabinet after pulling new cable into a 6.9 KV lift pump breaker cubicle when an arc flash occurred. The first employee suffered burns on the face, chest, and arms. The second employee suffered burns on the face, but mostly on the arms and hands. Both were hospitalized.
An employee was kicking ice from the forks of a forklift. He lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor, suffering back fractures.

A subcontractor employee on a construction site was cleaning a unit. They were taking trash from the middle room when they fell through a door opening and landed approximately 25 feet below on a concrete pad. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to their shoulders and right side ribs.
An employee was cleaning the tracks of a skid steer from outside the vehicle. The skid steer's boom moved vertically and pinched the employee against the tracks. His foot was broken.

An employee was operating a paper bag machine when his right middle finger was caught between the machine's frame and pusher arm, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was cleaning at a construction site when a board with a nail in it caught her pant leg, causing her to fall from the second to first floor. She was hospitalized with a broken right heel.
An employee was operating a weed eater cleaning around guard rails when he disturbed a yellow jacket nest and was stung numerous times, suffering an allergic reaction to the stings.

An employee was welding steel pieces that are approximately 120 inches in length, 90 inches wide, and 12 inches tall. An overhead crane was moving a part when the part fell and struck the employee's right leg. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the femur and fibula.
An employee was driving in a fence post using a fence post driver when the employee's fingertip was caught and amputated between the fence post and the driver.
On or about May 19, 2015, an employee was cleaning a moving roller on an extrusion machine with a rag when the machine pulled his left hand in. His left-hand index finger was injured.

An employee was cleaning a hopper when the rotary gate in the depositor moved, causing the employee's fingertip to become caught in the machine. The employee sustained an amputation to a fingertip on their left hand.
An employee was scanning freight and was struck by a forklift resulting in a broken leg and hospitalization.

An employee was taking electrical measurements from a battery interface board when it caused an arc flash. The employee suffered second degree burns to the left hand and first degree burns to the right hand.
An employee slipped on water and fell to the floor while walking to get water from a water dispenser where the drip tray had overflowed onto the floor. The employee suffered a right fibula fracture.

An employee was operating a forklift while his right hand was outside of the driving compartment. He drove near a dumpster and his hand became caught between the forklift and the dumpster, causing a soft tissue crush injury to his right hand between the index finger and the thumb.
An employee completed an auto glass replacement job outside and experienced light-headedness and weakness in their body. The employee sustained heat exhaustion.

Two employees were at Blackpoint Marina to repair a fuel leak on a customer's boat. The employees identified a corroded fuel valve (pickup) and replaced it. They were checking for additional leaks when a small explosion occurred in the bilge area. The ignition source may have been static electricity from a cell phone. Both employees received burns to their hands and faces and were hospitalized.

On May 15, 2020, an employee was carrying empty carboard boxes to place them in a metal crate used to transport the cardboard. After placing the cardboard on the metal crate, she turned to walk away and her pant leg became caught on a piece of metal wire sticking out about 1 inch from the crate's corner. She then fell on the floor and fractured her left hip, requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground hitting his head on an ergonomic stand. The employee impacted the left side of his forehead and was hospitalized with a brain bleed.

Three employees were cleaning out a dust collector that had jammed. They removed they auger to facilitate cleaning. The injured employee's right hand became entangled in a rotary airlock valve, resulting in an amputation of the first digit of their right index finger that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was preparing to close a restaurant and was cleaning when he cut his hand. The employee was hospitalized with a severe laceration.

Two employees were working on a roof that was approximately 18 feet above the lower level. The downspout for the grain bin (from a leg) was clogged and was removed by the two employees. While cleaning it, the injured employee slid off the roof and landed on their feet, fracturing their left ankle. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee's index finger was lacerated and partially amputated while adjusting a timing belt on a bagging machine. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee was cleaning out the screen on a plug catcher. The employee's left middle finger was caught between the screen and the deck of the plug catcher. The fingertip was amputated at the tuft of the last phalanx.

An employee was running a microwave bagging machine. A belt jammed; while the employee was fixing the jam, the employee's right index finger was amputated up to the first knuckle. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee was helping to adjust equipment. She tripped as she was walking around the equipment. When she reached out to catch her fall, her right hand entered the point of operation. The equipment activated, pinching and amputating her right pinky finger between the stockholder tab and discharge table.
An employee was working on the outside of the facility when they were struck by a forklift, resulting in fractures to their nose, three ribs, and left leg.
An employee was trying to move a pallet when his left pinky finger was caught between the pallet and a rack, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

Two welders were adjusting steel columns at the base plate when the tack welds holding up a 6 x 4 x 3/8-inch crossbeam failed. The beam fell 11 feet and struck the injured employee in the left rib area. The employee was hospitalized for T5-T7 vertebral fractures, fluid in the lungs, rib fractures, and bruising and contusions.
An employee had been using a hoist to add bulk bags of pigment to tanks in an area that was not air conditioned. The employee collapsed from heat stress and was hospitalized due to dehydration.
While closing a refuse compactor's door, a piece of cardboard started to fall out. The employee grabbed the cardboard and the compactor's door closed on his left hand, crushing two fingers.

An employee was adjusting the sliding support on a trailer (150 pounds) when the employee's right index finger was caught between the slide and trailer, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation.
An employee was maneuvering an aerial lift when he was caught between two aerial lifts.
An employee was walking through a cafeteria on the way to his office after delivering a package when he slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in a dislocated right shoulder.
An employee fell to the ground while performing maintenance on a crane, suffering a head injury.
A driver became light headed and nauseated at approximately 3:19p.m. on 7/19/16, at one of his truck stops. He was hospitalized for dehydration and heat stress.
An employee was on a ladder cleaning a piece of equipment when they fell approximately 8 feet from the ladder to the floor. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured hip and femur.

An employee was cleaning copper pipe staining from masonry surfaces with a chemical cleaning product when he became ill and started shaking. He was hospitalized with an inhalation upper respiratory illness.

An employee was attempting to remove the tube from a knurling machine when the machine pushed the tubing and the employee's hand into a pinch position against the base of the machine. The employee suffered a right middle finger amputation.

An employee was changing a lamp in a light fixture when he lost his balance and fell off an 8-foot ladder. He struck the concrete below and suffered a broken back bone, fractured skull, and brain trauma.

An employee was performing prime-up operations when a discharge hose with a winged connection came loose from a manifold trailer. Boost pressure was being applied to the hose, causing it to whip around and spray water. As the hose was whipping around, it struck and fractured the employee's lower left leg.
An employee was struck by a large 4  ft. X 2 ft. piston while cleaning a dough machine resulting in trauma to the forearm.

An employee was cleaning a gas pump, working inside a coned off area, while wearing a reflectorized vest. A vehicle entered the coned off area and ran over the employee's feet. The employee sustained a fractured right ankle.
An employee was repairing an overhead door spring. The spring bracket broke and struck the employee's right hand, resulting in a fractured right thumb and hand lacerations.
An employee was on the floor in a production area, closing concrete forms. His finger was caught in a pinch point between the bar and the latch of a form, and was partially amputated.
An employee was picking up blocks on the ground behind a forklift. The forklift operator struck the employee while backing up. The employee sustained an ankle bone fracture and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a rubber milling/mixing machine when his left hand became caught in the mill. He was able to remove it, but the skin was separated from his hand, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee dropped an ink pen on the floor and bent under the desk to retrieve it. The employee's head struck the desk while coming back up, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a drill press when his right hand was caught on the drill bit, partially amputating his thumb.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when they were struck by a pickup truck. The employee sustained a broken leg.
An employee was lifting a conveyance gate and caught their finger in a conveyance roller resulting in a severe abrasion that required surgery.
On August 1, 2016, an employee was cleaning the outside of a tanker truck when he became overheated. He was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.

Employee 1 was cleaning a paint gun using paint thinner when employee 2 started a lighter nearby and the cup of paint thinner ignited. Employee 2 dropped the cup and the ignited paint thinner spilled, causing burns on employee 2's arms, legs, hands, and face.

An employee was standing next to a powered industrial truck (PIT) and used the throttle to move the PIT to clear a loading dock space. The PIT reversed and struck the employee, fracturing her left leg.
On October 10, 2024, an employee was deep cleaning operating rooms and were exposed to disinfection cleaner, resulting in an acute environmental asthma exacerbation. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was webbing up and feeding paper into a commercial offset web press. He used his right hand to unjam some paper when his hand and fingers got caught and pinched between the blanket cylinders of the press.

An employee was relocating a parking sign. While digging the relocation hole, the employee made contact with a cracked, buried PVC pipe. The employee initially thought it was irrigation piping, but upon closer examination saw electrical wiring and received a shock while attempting to isolate the exposed wiring.

An employee was climbing a ladder at the upper level of an office building when he lost his balance and fell to a landing one level below. He then fell from the landing to the ground level, resulting in a fractured clavicle.
A metal delivery truck cart, carrying boxes, rolled down a loading ramp. It struck and broke an employee's leg.

An employee was hooking up a pipe to unload product when a chemical reaction occurred and they were exposed to chlorine gas. The employee sustained chemical burns to the nasal cavity, throat and lungs.
An employee was spraying a cleaning chemical foam in a hallway. The hose came loose, spraying chemicals in the employee's eye. The employee was hospitalized.

On February 24, 2022, an employee was on top of a rotary die cutter, cleaning the print cylinder. The employee's right hand was crushed between the cylinder and the pressure roll. The employee's ring and little fingers were amputated. The equipment was not locked out at the time.

An employee was cleaning the house of the grain probe machine and their left hand was caught inside the opened area of the probe cylinder resulting in partial amputations to the middle and index fingers.
An employee was struck by a forklift while taking inventory. The employee suffered an open fracture of the left ankle.
An employee was checking the tension on a belt on a vehicle. The employee's left hand was pulled into the belt and pulley, causing a partial amputation of the left index finger.

An employee was communicating with the driver of a construction vehicle when the vehicle struck the employee, pulling him beneath the vehicle's tracks and resulting in broken ribs, a broken pelvis, and multiple fractures to both legs.
